#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

const long long mod = 998244353;

long long fastpow(long long n, long long ti) {
    if (ti == 0) return 1LL;
    if (ti % 2 == 0) {
        long long y = fastpow(n, ti / 2);
        long long k = y * y;
        k %= mod;
        return k;
    } else {
        long long y = fastpow(n, ti / 2);
        long long k = ((n * y) % mod) * y;
        k %= mod;
        return k;
    }
}

long long modInv(long long x) {
    long long t = 0, newt = 1, r = mod, newr = x;
    while (newr != 0) {
        long long q = r / newr;
        long long temp = t; t = newt; newt = temp - q * newt;
        temp = r; r = newr; newr = temp - q * newr;
    }
    if (r > 1) return 0;
    if (t < 0) t += mod;
    return t;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    
    if (l == r) {
        cout << 1 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    long long odds = ((r + 1) / 2) - (l / 2);
    long long evens = (r / 2) - ((l - 1) / 2);
    
    long long ans;
    if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
        ans = fastpow(odds + evens, n * m);
    } else {
        ans = (fastpow(odds + evens, n * m) + fastpow(odds - evens, n * m)) % mod;
        ans = (ans * modInv(2)) % mod;
    }
    
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
